subject: Activation MAP — staggered commit cadence, TPM tiers & closing timeline
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@edgebank.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Activation MAP — draft & quick decision points

Hi Aisha,

Thanks again for the demo last week — great conversation. As promised, attached is a first-pass MAP that sequences evaluation milestones, acceptance criteria, and the commercial ramps we discussed. High level asks:

- Confirmation of acceptance criteria for POC (latency, throughput, data handling)
- Preferred ramp speed (conservative vs aggressive) so we can model pricing bands
- Procurement timeline (target PO date) so we can align discounted milestones

Key commercial note up front: we propose a tiered-commit structure linked to monthly tokens (TPM). Discounts and credits kick in at defined slabs; we also include a modest acceptance credit if EdgeBank meets POC SLAs but misses early volume targets.

I attached: MAP-draft-v1.pdf (MAP with milestones) and a simple TPM-schedule.xlsx we can iterate on. If you can confirm availability, I’ll schedule a 30-min sync tomorrow to walk through the pricing table.

Thanks — Jonas

Jonas Weber
Head of Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP-draft-v1.pdf (application/pdf), TPM-schedule.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@edgebank.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@edgebank.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Activation MAP — draft & quick decision points

Thanks Jonas — appreciate the fast turnaround. I reviewed the MAP and have a few questions before the sync:

1) Can you show a small / medium / fast ramp pricing comparison in the TPM sheet? We need visible per-token CPI bands for budgeting.
2) Procurement will need a conservative close date; can you confirm what discounting is available if we commit to a 12-month tiered volume vs a shorter 6-month ramp?
3) Security is requesting SOC2 evidence and logging retention details — we’ll loop in security separately, but helpful if you can note those items in the MAP.

We’re aiming to present to the procurement committee on Dec 9. If we want a signed PO before year-end, we’ll need final commercials by Dec 6. Can you accommodate?

Aisha Malik
Director, AI Platforms | EdgeBank
aisha.malik@edgebank.com | +1 (212) 555-0789

Attachment: edgebank-scope.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@edgebank.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Activation MAP — draft & quick decision points

Aisha — thanks, outlined below is a concise pricing / ramp matrix and escalation mechanics. I’ve updated the TPM-schedule.xlsx and attached for reference. Key points: 

- Scenario A (Conservative): Months 1-3: 4M TPM, Months 4-6: 12M TPM, Steady: 30M TPM
  - Baseline price: $0.0009/token; no discount until steady threshold
- Scenario B (Accelerated): Months 1-2: 8M TPM, Months 3-4: 25M TPM, Steady: 60M TPM
  - Baseline price: $0.00085/token; 7% discount when monthly usage >= 50M tokens
- Scenario C (Commit 12-mo Tiered): Commit to 36M TPM avg over 12 months
  - Baseline price: $0.0008/token with retroactive true-up and 10% discount applied quarterly when committed avg met

Discount triggers and credits:
- 5% credit if POC meets acceptance criteria but monthly usage < 50% of target in first 2 months (to avoid churn risk)
- Auto-escalate to fallback model variant if we observe latency regressions; Redwood covers retraining-time CPU costs for the fallback window

Proposed ramp clause language (summary):
- EdgeBank provides a target monthly TPM schedule as part of the MAP. If actual usage < 50% of scheduled TPM for two consecutive months, Redwood will apply a credit equal to 30% of the difference (applied in next invoice) and offer a joint remediation plan.

Timeline: to hit your procurement ask (final commercials by Dec 6) we need acceptance of scenario and legal redlines by EOD Dec 4. Ben — recommending we prepare a 2-column redline for signature and a PO template.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567 (updated with scenarios)

-Jonas

Attachments: TPM-schedule.xlsx (updated)

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@edgebank.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 14:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Activation MAP — draft & quick decision points

Jonas / Aisha — quick suggestion from pricing: offer a short-term onboarding credit to de-risk early months and tighten the close timeline. Proposed alternate structure (simple):

- Pilot (M1–M3): 5M TPM (discounted at $0.0010/token), Redwood issues a $15k onboarding credit applied to M2 invoice if acceptance criteria met.
- Ramp (M4–M6): 20M TPM avg ($0.0009/token).
- Steady (M7+): 50M TPM avg ($0.00075/token) with a 12-month commit for the best rate.

Discount ladder: 5% at 25M, 10% at 40M, 15% at 60M monthly slabs.

If procurement needs a PO by Dec 1 (tight), propose we do a commercial term sheet today and ask legal to hold redlines until Dec 4 — that gets procurement comfortable. I’ll draft the term sheet and the two-column redline template Jonas mentioned.

—Ben

Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-2034

From: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@edgebank.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Procurement <procurement@edgebank.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Dec 2026 16:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Activation MAP — draft & quick decision points

Jonas / Ben — appreciate the options and rapid iteration. EdgeBank is prepared to proceed on Scenario B with the following conditional items before we issue a PO by Dec 15: 

- Final contract with the ramp schedule from Scenario B (M1–2: 8M, M3–4: 25M, Steady 60M)
- 7% discount at >=50M tokens as noted; 10% retroactive true-up if 12-mo committed avg met
- Onboarding credit: $12k applied if POC acceptance criteria met in month 2
- SOC2 Type II report and logging/retention appendix to satisfy security (we will share the security questionnaire)
- Standard procurement PO and vendor info (I attached a procurement scope for legal)

If you can deliver redlines and SOC2 evidence by EOD Monday Dec 6 we will route to procurement and target PO issuance by Dec 15. Otherwise we’ll need to push. Please also include the MAP-draft-v1 with explicit acceptance criteria inserted for each milestone.

Thanks — looking forward to closing quickly.

Aisha Malik
Director, AI Platforms | EdgeBank

Attachment: edgebank-scope.pdf (procurement scope)
